##### Project general facts

Rixos Residences is an exclusive beachfront development that combines refined architecture with a resort-style lifestyle. The project features a selection of 1 to 3-bedroom apartments, spacious duplexes, beach houses, and villas, all set within a beautifully landscaped environment with direct beach access. Designed to reflect elegance and comfort, the residences offer contemporary layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and expansive terraces with stunning views of the sea and surrounding landscape.

The community is designed to deliver a full resort experience, with an on-site Rixos hotel and a wide range of premium amenities. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, lush garden terraces, wellness facilities, and a variety of water sports, creating a vibrant yet relaxed atmosphere. Family-friendly spaces and leisure areas ensure a balanced lifestyle, where comfort, entertainment, and relaxation are seamlessly combined in a private coastal setting.

The residences are designed to maximise indoor and outdoor living, with spacious balconies, terraces, and private gardens overlooking the sea. Duplex units feature private terraces with swimming pools, while beach houses offer two-level layouts with generous living spaces. Interiors are finished with porcelain tile flooring, engineered wood elements, wood veneer cabinetry, and engineered stone countertops, complemented by elegant metal accents. Kitchens are fully equipped with modern appliances, and the residences are offered unfurnished.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a major waterfront destination located along Dubai’s northern coastline, designed as a collection of four interconnected islands that combine residential, hospitality, leisure, and entertainment experiences. The area is being developed around a relaxed coastal lifestyle, with expansive waterfront spaces, sandy beaches, landscaped promenades, and views across the Arabian Gulf.

The destination offers a diverse mix of residential communities, luxury hotels, retail, dining, and recreational facilities, creating a vibrant environment for both residents and visitors. Its waterfront setting provides opportunities for beach activities, water sports, cycling, and leisurely walks, while landscaped public spaces and promenades create a peaceful connection with nature.

Dubai Islands also benefits from convenient connectivity to the rest of the city through major road networks, with Dubai International Airport, Downtown Dubai, and other key destinations within easy reach. With its combination of beachfront living, modern infrastructure, and growing selection of lifestyle amenities, Dubai Islands is emerging as one of Dubai’s distinctive new coastal destinations.
